title: Bitcoin AI Model Review — Week 32: 1 of 4 Calls Correct
meta_description: Week 32 graded: 1 of 4 Bitcoin calls correct (25%). All-time: 25.0% over 4 public calls. Paper portfolio +0.6% vs holding. Logged before outcomes were knowable.

intro: This is the week 32 recap for the date range 2026-08-05 to 2026-08-08.
Out of 4 week resolved calls, the model logged 1 week hit, giving a week accuracy of 25.0 percent.
A failed high confidence buy call on Wednesday marked the worst stumble of the period.
days: On Wednesday the model issued an incorrect buy signal with 85.1 percent confidence while price changed negative 0.43 percent.
Thursday provided the single correct call, a hold signal at 51.8 percent confidence with a price change of 0.16 percent.
Friday followed with a hold signal at 49.1 percent confidence that failed as price shifted 1.27 percent.
On Saturday a buy signal at 61.3 percent confidence was incorrect after a 0.32 percent change.
trend: For alltime performance, the model stands at 1 hit out of 4 alltime resolved calls.
That puts the alltime accuracy at 25.0 percent, matching this week's result.
There is no change in the long term trajectory yet.

research.title: Why the model sometimes refuses to call a direction
paragraphs: When the ensemble's confidence falls below its threshold, a gate downgrades the call to hold.
A forced guess would look decisive and grade like a coin flip. The gate would rather say nothing.
